sources.snippet: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, the first model released by DiffuSpace. Clover delivers state-of-the-art performance among open-source diffusion language models at release on the benchmarks reported in our launch blog. Built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Clover combines a text-only mixture-of-experts backbone with block diffusion generation: 35B total parameters, approximately 3B active per token ...
